meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当用户要求报告 bug 时，Claude 会先调查并定位缺陷所属的项目，然后生成一份结构化的 GitHub issue（特定情况下为 PR），包含复现步骤、根因和修复建议，并自动加上 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交、打开或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 等软件的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个 LazyCodex 报 bug，写清楚复现步骤和根因。
say.note: Claude 会调查并生成 issue 草稿。

say.text: 把这条 Codex 的 bug 整理成 issue 并发到 GitHub。
say.note: Claude 会创建并发布 issue。

howto.what_en: Claude investigates the reported bug, determines the owning repo, and creates a structured GitHub issue (or PR when allowed) with reproduction steps, root cause, and fix approach, adding the lazycodex-generated label.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex, or similar software.

say_en.text: Report a bug for LazyCodex with reproduction steps and root cause.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate and draft an issue.

say_en.text: Should this Codex issue go to openai/codex or code-yeongyu/lazycodex?
say_en.note: Claude will decide the target repo.

say_en.text: Turn this Codex bug into an issue and post it to GitHub.
say_en.note: Claude will create and publish the issue.
